page.layout: One block of text, one printed page. Running head "LIBER QUARTUS" with page number 437 at top right. Single column of text, justified. Catchword "com-" at the lower right below the last line. No marginal notes beyond the bullet-like marks, which are stains or specks and not printed text.

main_text.p: um, unum essentia, sed trinum ratione personarum æqualiter ratione originis, dignitatis, atque cultus se habentium, nullibi tamen definite aut tangit, aut indicat principia constituentia, communi modo se habentia. sensus quoque hanc difficultatem non expedit, quum enim occupetur circa singularia, & duntaxat adhæreat objecto sibi definito, aut universaliter aut particulariter sese ratione sui habenti; neutiquam index esse potest principiorum universali ratione se habentium: sive enim dicas ea ex accidenti & per aliud duntaxat sentiri, sive sentiri in singularibus, sensus hac in parte submotum is. nam si duntaxat ex accidenti hæc principia qua talia sentiuntur, eo ipso sensum vaspectum reddis, idem enim facis ac si contenderes in crumena numis repleta, tibique oblata, numos necessario aureos esse debere. ad hoc, ex singularibus si faciendum sit judicium, illa omnia ut sensibus offerenda essent, aut saltem liquido deberet constare, pauca, quæ offeruntur, indubitatum indicium omnium facere. Ad hoc, ratio sibi soli relicta non potest ad communissima hæc principia pervenire: vel enim ideam eorum mens circumferet, & sic omnes (ut in axiomatibus Mathematicis contingit) qui modo terminos intelligent, suo suffragio hæc principia com-
main_text.notes: Faint specks and stains in the margins are not printed text. The character after "sensum" appears to be a damaged word and is read as "aspectum" with doubt. Several words are set in a worn type and may be misread; the first word is a fragment "um" from "unum" cut off at the left edge.
